Platform Science is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Core Product Development team in Chennai. - Compatibility Testing: Deep understanding of backward compatibility testing across varying operating system versions and device configurations. 
- Test Design Methodologies: Strong applied knowledge of test design techniques, including Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and Use Case testing.
